description.value: Small forested lakefront campground on Highway 16 just 16 km east of Prince Rupert, with lake paddling, fishing for five Pacific salmon species, and swimming; nearby Diana Lake Park adds a coastal rainforest trail. Easy highway access makes it a convenient overnight or layover on the North Coast.

address.value: 16 km East of Prince Rupert on Hwy 16, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Prudhomme Lake Park is an active provincial campground 16 km east of Prince Rupert on Hwy 16, with 24 sites (OSM capacity tag), accepting tents and caravans. Reservations are confirmed via the frontcountry camping reservation system described on the website. The OSM operator field says 'Northwest Escapes Ltd.' but the website states 'This park is operated by Wilderness Recreation Services Ltd.' — a significant discrepancy suggesting the OSM contact details (phone, email) may be outdated. No specific amenity details (water, showers, shelters, hiker/biker sites) are mentioned on the website for this campground.
concerns: OSM operator field says 'Northwest Escapes Ltd.' but the BC Parks website states the park is operated by 'Wilderness Recreation Services Ltd.' — the OSM phone (+1-250-638-8490) and email (nwescapesbc@telus.net) likely belong to the former operator and may be outdated.
No street address available; location is described only as '16 km East of Prince Rupert on Hwy 16'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground directly on Highway 16 near Prince Rupert, a key corridor for touring cyclists in northern BC. Accepts tents and reservations.
